requirements.text: · 3-7+ years of experience building solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform, with demonstrable experience delivering Power Apps and Power BI solutions.
· Strong proficiency in Power Apps, Power BI, DAX, Power Fx, Power Query, data modeling, SQL, and Microsoft Dataverse.
· Experience integrating Microsoft 365 and business systems using APIs, connectors, dataflows, or related integration methods.
· Solid understanding of software development practices, documentation, testing, source control, environment management, data security, and governance.
· Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
· Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams, offices, and time zones.
· Strong attention to detail, sound technical judgment, and a practical, service-oriented approach to solution delivery.
· Experience in a law firm or professional services environment, or with systems such as Aderant, iManage, or legal CRM platforms, is preferred.
· Microsoft certifications such as PL-100, PL-200, PL-300, PL-400, or PL-600 are preferred.
· Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, PCF component development, RPA / desktop flows, custom connectors, CI/CD, or ALM for Power Platform is a plus.
